page_title: VAL 2-3 PAL | Valencia v Las Palmas 21/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
90+5' Jesus Gil Manzano sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+5' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano has indicated he is going to review the Valencia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+4' 2 - 3 Goal! Jose Gaya picks out Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 2:3.
90+3' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' Andre Almeida (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:6.
84' 1 - 3 Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
82' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' Hugo Duro (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
79' Surely that's handball by one of the Las Palmas players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
77' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
75' Substitution. Javi Guerra (Valencia) replaces Dani Gomez.
75' Substitution. Thierry Correia walks off the pitch and Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
74' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Substitution. Juanma Herzog (Las Palmas) has come on for Alex Munoz.
74' Viti (Las Palmas) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Benito Ramirez.
69' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card for infringement.
69' The referee interrupts the game and gives a red card to Pepelu (Valencia). He can take an early bath.
69' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
68' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:5.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Adnan Januzaj.
66' Ruben Baraja has decided to substitute Ro and he is replaced by Jose Gaya (Valencia).
66' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fabio Silva walks off.
63' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) plays a through ball but overhits it.
62' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' A pass into the penalty area from Dani Gomez (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
59' That will be all from Jose Campana who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
55' Substitution. Andre Almeida (Valencia) in, Enzo Barrenechea out.
55' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Diego Lopez (Valencia) replaces Sergi Canos.
53' 1 - 2 Goal! Jose Campana produces a great pass that finds Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
52' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
49' Las Palmas take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

49' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a superb save. Las Palmas force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

48' Thierry Correia (Valencia) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Dani Gomez (Valencia), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
43' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
43' PENALTY APPEAL by Las Palmas, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

42' Giorgi Mamardashvili was forced into action to thwart Fabio Silva (Las Palmas). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
38' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort.
38' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jesus Gil Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Thierry Correia (Valencia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
35' Thierry Correia (Valencia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
30' Ro (Valencia) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
28' Viti (Las Palmas) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

25' Thierry Correia (Valencia) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Jasper Cillessen guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Now Valencia have a corner.
23' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul.
19' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.

18' Hugo Duro (Valencia) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Jasper Cillessen makes a brilliant save! The linesman makes the right call and Valencia will have a corner.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jasper Cillessen into the top right corner.
14' Pepelu (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
14' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Gil Manzano signals. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Valencia.
13' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
8' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
8' What was Pepelu (Valencia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
7' Fabio Silva (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jesus Gil Manzano had an easy-decision to make.
6' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Luis Rioja (Valencia). The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner.
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dani Gomez (Valencia).
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
